candidateLineEndings: LF (no terminal LF — matches remote file convention)
ledgerOpen: sessionStorage is per-tab — drafts still die with the tab and can be evicted by the browser under storage pressure; the draftLost tombstone converts quota/size refusals into a warn-on-reopen, but a true tab-close or full eviction leaves no trace (out of reach within sessionStorage).
Draft-vs-source merge conflicts beyond the existing baseUpdatedAt warning are not resolved — restore replaces design+pricing fields wholesale after a confirm.
Partial Builder-sync retry for drafted pricing remains open (out of scope per ledger).
Live authorization/refresh coverage remains open (out of scope per ledger).

Nav guard covers internal anchor clicks + Back/Forward while mounted; programmatic navigate() calls from outside the page component (none currently) would bypass it — the synchronous draft backup remains the safety net.
Forward traversal while dirty can land on the sentinel and re-arm (harmless no-op) — documented bounded wart.
